text:
maria: Quick check — I'm finishing the doc-driven quickstart PRD. Need final acceptance criteria and edge cases. Goal: ship an example customers can copy and run within 10–15 minutes.
eva: I opened a docs PR with the examples folder. link: https://git.redwood/docs/pull/278 — still rough, needs AC and a short checklist.
jin: Two infra notes: private deploy needs VPC hints, and we should call out model size/quantization path for the quickstart so it doesn't OOM on tiny machines.
nate: For devex: include a one-file config users can paste. Minimal commands + a `make quickstart` target.
maria: Here's a compact AC proposal (put this in the PR as a checkbox list):
```
Acceptance criteria (v1 quickstart):
- runnable end-to-end in <=15 minutes on a developer laptop or small cloud VM
- includes both hosted API example and a "local" minimal private deploy config
- explicit callouts for model variant selection (cpu vs gpu, quantized path)
- one-click (or one-command) build + run: `make quickstart` or `redwood quickstart run`
- example prompts + expected output snippets for smoke tests
- automated e2e test: `make quickstart-e2e` passes in CI
- docs page has troubleshooting section (common errors + quick fixes)
```
sam: Add performance SLO note: smoke test should return first token within 500ms for hosted example (so we can detect regressions).
eva: Edge cases to document: network timeouts during model download, insufficient disk, KMS errors for private, auth token expired. I'll add short remediation steps.
jin: Also add: fallback behavior when GPU not available (explicit warning + CPU fallback path). For private, show a minimal `alloc.yaml` with fallback to smaller model.
nate: I'll create the one-file config and a tiny `Dockerfile` snippet for the PR.
docs-bot: PR #278 updated with AC checklist and example config (https://git.redwood/docs/pull/278) :white_check_mark:
eva: Can someone review the edge cases list? I linked examples in the PR.
sam: Reviewing now, focusing on SLO wording and smoke test script.
maria: Let's freeze AC by EOD Friday so engineering can scope the work for the sprint. If anyone needs scope negotiation, call it out here.
jin: Two scope asks: (1) we should not include Dedicated autoscaling examples in v1 — too much surface, (2) include one private-deploy note but mark advanced networking as v2.
maria: agreed on both. We'll call autoscaling/rollouts v2. Keep v1 focused on onboarding and reproducible quickstart.
eva: I'll rename the examples folder to `quickstarts/v1` and add a changelog entry.
nate: I'll add `make quickstart-e2e` that runs a simple smoke against hosted mock and the local container.
sam: LGTM from SE side. I'll craft a one-paragraph customer-facing blurb for the docs: short, clear benefits + minimal prerequisites.
maria: Thanks. Owners: eva — docs + examples, nate — scripts & Dockerfile, jin — infra notes. Deadline: Friday EOD for AC and PR ready for final review. :thumbsup:
eva: Will do. Adding TODO comments in the PR for the follow-ups. :eyes:
maria: If anyone hits blockers, ping me or @maria PM.
sam: +1
docs-bot: Reminder: docs PRs must include a simple smoke test to merge (CI check).
maria: Closing thread — we'll reconvene if any unresolved items remain after the PR updates. :party:
